_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
sub_palette: lizardman (Kazhur regressed - smooth sustained hisses + sibilants)
homeland: no fixed homeland (marsh-deeps, sunken temples, water-mounds)

branch.regression: smooth sustained hisses + sibilants (sh/s/z/ss prominent and drawn, cold and even, suffix -ssa/-isk/-aza)
branch.nature: cold reptile-folk; ancient, patient, and the most articulate reptile; marsh-lords
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into a lizardman's cold even hiss

_note: Beastman culture: LIZARDMEN, cold reptile-folk - Kazhur rotted into smooth, sustained hisses and sibilants (qatal 'kill' -> Khatazza). Ancient, patient marsh-lords; the most articulate of the reptile beastmen. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Old Serpent / the Cold Coil). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Lizardman (Kazhur, smooth-hiss regression): sh/s/z/ss prominent and drawn out, cold and even (not foul like the trog), suffixes -ssa/-isk/-aza; sustained, sibilant, articulate.
phonology.phonotactics: CV(s)sa with long sibilants; cold even stress.

morphology.naming_marker: named in a cold hiss by the kashazza; a sibilant lineage-name (lizardmen keep long egg-clutch lines).

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief (clutch-head) of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord (Scale-Overlord) over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / clutch-clan - the most settled beastmen, marsh-mound holds (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

county.scope: great scale-chief over a few clanholds

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic, and ancient. Race-totem the OLD SERPENT (Rab-Nakhazza) / the Cold Coil. More totem-bound than the other beastmen - the Old Serpent is venerated above the distant Gul-spirits. The Kashazza hisses to the serpent at the sunken temple; the One and the Lawful sun demonized (though the cold-blood grudgingly basks in the sun's warmth).
religion.race_totem: the Old Serpent (Rab-Nakhazza) / the Cold Coil

demonized.Tulrius (the Lawful sun): Tarul the Burning-Eye (the judge-sun; basked in, never bowed to)

religion.tribal_totem_pattern: [Rab-Nakhazza-/Dazza-/Cold-] + [serpent or scale]: Rab-Nakhazza (the Old Serpent), Dazza-tsipaza (Blood-Claw).
religion.shaman_rites: cold hiss-chants at the sunken temple and the serpent-mound; the egg-clutch blessing; the shedding-rite.

holy_symbol_motifs.Old Serpent: a great coiled serpent swallowing the sun
holy_symbol_motifs.Gul-Waqidu: a cold spiral into the dark

banks_patterns.war_bands: the hiss-named clutches: 'the Old Serpent', 'the Cold Coils', 'the Scale-lords of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: marsh-deeps, sunken temples, and water-mounds: 'the Sunken Temple of [clan]', 'the Serpent-mound of [chief]', 'the Marsh-deep of [name]'
